name: Windows
notes: Windows 10 or 11. The installer is unsigned, so SmartScreen warns on first launch: choose More info, then Run anyway. A portable zip is on the release page.

name: Android
notes: Ion 1.0.1. Installed and started on Moto G32 / Android 13. Open the APK in Files and allow installation from that source if prompted. Uses the existing test signing certificate and installs over the previous Ion build.
